figurative_meaning_en: To become extremely irritated and angry
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার ব্যবহারে আমার পিত্তি চটে গেল।
এই অবিচার দেখে সকলের পিত্তি জ্বলে উঠল।
example_sentences_in_english: His behavior made my bile rise.
Seeing this injustice, everyone's anger flared up.
history: Derived from the Ayurvedic concept of 'pitta' dosha, where imbalance in bile humor is associated with anger and heat in the body.
note: The idiom reflects traditional Indian humoral theory influencing Bengali expressions of emotion.
